_about: Bug regions in Muse Code's PRs, labelled by hand from the failing fix test and the human fix (same rule as SZZ on the evaluation set: the region the fix had to change). Each label is a file and a line in the agent's new file; the region holding that line is the bug region.

boltons@89bb0a8b96.why: the new elif chain in singularize still strips the trailing s of words ending in 'ss'; the fix adds the missing branch here

sqlglot@47e255dda3.why: COUNT(*) FILTER special case checks exp.Star only, missing table.* stars; the fix rewrites this check

packaging@e80f70f8b1.why: dir_info check accepts file: URLs with a relative path; the fix splits this check and adds the absolute-path test

isort@8b450398ef.why: swapping in a StringIO for a non-seekable stream; the fix replaces this with an explicit ValueError

more-itertools@eb24d3927a.why: islice(iterable, start, stop) rejects the negative stop the fast path accepts; the fix guards this slow path

packaging@ee13ba2c1c.why: the fast path iterates the version before checking it is a string, so non-strings raise TypeError, not InvalidVersion

more-itertools@a50ab3eebb.why: peek appends to the cache, which drops the item when maxlen is 0; the fix puts the item back here

es-toolkit@97e4eee74a.why: only NaN is coerced; fractional and string fromIndex are not converted to an integer like lodash

valibot@a0aa98555c.why: the domain regex the fix rewrites (case handling); the fix also adds the missing to-json-schema case, which is outside this PR

immer@8848a5b169.why: Map draft forEach reads latest() without preparing the copy, so iteration breaks under mutation.
